twin.en: Hmm. Interesting. Well, some common questions for twins include: "Do you have psychic powers?
twin.zh: 嗯。很有意思。好吧，人们对双胞胎常问的问题包括：“你们有特异功能吗？

twin.en: Non-identical, or fraternal, twins come from two separate eggs and share half their genes.
twin.zh: 非同卵双胞胎（即异卵双胞胎）来自两个不同的卵子，共享一半的基因。

twin.en: In studies, Professor Harper found positive twins stayed healthier than negative twins as they aged.
twin.zh: 在研究中，Harper教授发现，心态积极的双胞胎在变老时比心态消极的双胞胎保持得更健康。

twin.en: In studies, Professor Harper found positive twins stayed healthier than negative twins as they aged.
twin.zh: 在研究中，Harper教授发现，心态积极的双胞胎在变老时比心态消极的双胞胎保持得更健康。

twin.en: A piece of the puzzle means a part of the solution to a problem – in this case, the twin problems of food security and climate change.
twin.zh: “解决问题的一环”（a piece of the puzzle）是指问题解决方案的一部分——在这种情况下，是指粮食安全和气候变化这两个双重问题。

twist.en: The army was deployed, but in a twist, they refused to fire on the protestors.
twist.zh: 军队被部署了，但在一个转折中，他们拒绝向抗议者开枪。

twist.en: Will's view of the world became distorted – twisted out of shape and unrealistic.
twist.zh: Will 对世界的看法变得扭曲(distorted)——也就是变形失真、脱离现实。

twist.en: You may recognise this as the start of Charles Dickens' Oliver Twist.
twist.zh: 你可能认出这是 Charles Dickens 的《Oliver Twist》的开头。

twist.en: That has been forever consigned to the pages of Oliver Twist.
twist.zh: 那个已经被永远封存在《Oliver Twist》的字里行间了。

twist.en: If you give something a twist, you change it in some small way to create something new and exciting.
twist.zh: 如果你给某事 give a twist（赋予新意 / 作出改变），你就会在某些小地方对其进行改变，以创造出新奇有趣的东西。
